purpose: Manual behavioral checks for future revisions. Run each prompt in a fresh agent context with the skill and only task-local artifacts. Keep evaluation criteria out of the task prompt.
evaluation: Assess observed decisions and evidence, not stylistic similarity. Mark an assertion not observed when required source or runtime evidence is missing. Do not count these cases as automated or passed merely because this file parses.

Prioritizes task hierarchy and readable status
